reviewer_statement: Developer-side scientific full-source semantic review of the published Python 1.2 manuscript reporting text. A shared 30-string frozen Python typed dataclass oracle covers five reporting exports, two variants and three precision settings. Native R must preserve complete text, scientific disclaimers and correct numerical formatting. Python typed class and exception identity are not native R types; independent review and exact-head qualification pending.
native_language_semantic_policy: The Python 1.2 result dataclass is represented by a validated native R scientific record; the Python str return is native R character of length one, without invoking a Python engine. Full textual equality is independently tested per source-typed reference fixture and formatting setting.

case_evidence.description: Python source function requires typed published scientific dataclass plus keyword-only digits; native R accepts checked source-shaped record and integer digits, returning one manuscript string.
Two complete source-domain cases with no or declared independent grouping, family plus-one versus empirical adjustment, selected versus no selected h, and digits 0,3,5.
30 full-character exact frozen Python 1.2 versus native R manuscript reporting strings, including formatting percentages, medians, inference component counts, thresholds and bootstrap counts.

Native R rejects invalid numerical science fields, negative digits, incomplete family flags, improper confidence bounds, and nonconsecutive truncation grid. Python exception-class identity remains language-specific.
Exactly one complete plain-text reporting string, preserving scientific caveats, quotation of multiplier/independent-unit names and published sentence order.

Clopper-Pearson finite-bootstrap Monte Carlo precision and decision sensitivity; does not change scientific test decisions; Only textual scientific reporting of already computed wild-bootstrap results; no new bootstrap draws, null-test changes, false precision, new estimator or external Python runtime dependency.

independent_review_status: Developer semantic source review only; exact-head 3-OS R and frozen Python 1.2 CI plus independent audit pending
language_specific_limits: Frozen Python dataclass is native R checked list/S3, not class-identical
Python str return maps to native R scalar character, not identical runtime class
Python TypeError/ValueError conditions have native R semantic error counterparts only
Arbitrary malformed Python object graphs are not accepted native R scientific records
